edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from NIFC Breitkopf & Hartel first-edition encoding; corrected by complete both-staff model review against exact Paderewski Polonaises PDF pp.34-40. The Troupenas encoding was checked as an alternative candidate only and was not used.

Derived corrections are separate; no scan redistributed.
verified_scope: chord membership and independent voice attacks
omitted_or_unverified_scope: first-repeat forte is retained as an explicit second-pass direction, not an unconditional dynamic target
corrections: Fold source 19-34, which literally writes out the repeat of 3-18, into the printed repeat signs; source 35-133 becomes printed 19-117.
Restore lower-staff placement of the opening low chord in 19, shared B3 in 35, closing D3 in 36, runs 37-39 and initial C3 in 40. Preserve separate simultaneous unison voices.
Sustain the B4 at beat 3 of 35 as a quarter and tie it into 36, while keeping the simultaneous G4 in its own voice.
Restore the dotted-quarter A4 under the upper melody in 66, in place of a quarter followed by an eighth rest.
Correct the initial upper Db5 to Eb5 in 68 and the F4 at the tenth sixteenth position to E4 in 80.
Tie the final C5 of 81 into the sustained C5 of 82, preserving the continuation within 82; restore upright fermata there.
Restore the C-minor key at 101 (rather than a conversion cancellation), final upper G4 tie 116-117 and both final fermatas.
Replace unreviewed source expression marks with the scan-reviewed p/pp/f/ff/fff levels and tempo words.
